sloka: या भाति  लक्ष्मीर्भुवि मन्दरस्था ।तथा प्रदोषेषु च सागरस्था ।तथैव तोयेषु च पुष्करस्था ।रराज सा चारुनिशाकरस्था ॥५-५-३॥
transliteration: yā bhāti  lakṣmīrbhuvi mandarasthā ।tathā pradoṣeṣu ca sāgarasthā ।tathaiva toyeṣu ca puṣkarasthā ।rarāja sā cāruniśākarasthā ॥5-5-3॥

translations.english: 'The same splendour on the Mandara mountain on earth, which glows at dusk lay on the ocean is there, on lotuses in the lakes and on the beautiful Moon also.
